title: Hydra — workflow.yaml
description: Orchestration of several Hydra jobs and actions, expressed as a dependency graph.

name.description: Workflow name. Appears in logs and run results.

steps.description: Workflow steps. Execution order is driven by 'depends_on', not by list order. Step names must be unique.

enumDescriptions: manual — started on demand with hdrctl workflow run.
schedule — started automatically according to 'cron'. The 'cron' field becomes required.
webhook — started by an incoming HTTP call.

cron.description: Five-field cron expression: minute hour day month weekday. Required when type is 'schedule'.

name.description: Step identifier, unique within the workflow. Other steps refer to it in their 'depends_on'.

enumDescriptions: job — runs a Hydra job. The 'job' field becomes required.
action — runs a built-in action. The 'action' field becomes required.

job.description: Path to the job directory, relative to workflow.yaml. The directory must contain sources.yaml, destinations.yaml and pipeline.yaml.

enumDescriptions: log — write a message to the workflow log.
delay — pause the workflow.
condition — evaluate an expression and branch on the result.
webhook — send an HTTP request.
email — send an email.
bash — run a shell command (Linux/macOS).
powershell — run a PowerShell command (Windows).
ssh — run a command on a remote host.
python — run Python code.
set_param — define a runtime parameter for later steps.
assign_param — assign a computed value to a runtime parameter.

params.description: Action parameters. Values may reference a runtime parameter using the {{ param:NAME }} syntax.

depends_on.description: Names of the steps that must finish before this one. An empty list starts the step immediately. Steps sharing the same dependencies run in parallel.

on_failure.description: What happens when this step fails.
enumDescriptions: fail — stop the workflow. The default; keep it for critical steps.
skip — mark the step as skipped and carry on.
continue — carry on despite the failure.

enabled.description: Set to false to disable a step without deleting it from the file.

when.description: Conditional guard: the step runs only when the expression is true.

retryPolicy.description: Retry policy applied when the step fails.

max.description: Number of retries AFTER the first failure. 0 disables retrying.

backoff.description: How the delay evolves between attempts.
enumDescriptions: fixed — constant delay.
exponential — delay doubles on each attempt. Recommended for network calls.
